_comment: Example archive-source config for: py scripts/build_tier1_dataset.py --use-archive --archive-config data/archive_sources.example.json
Each entry configures one ArchiveScraper. Only point this at sources you are AUTHORIZED to archive.

By default every source is checked for AI-scraping opt-out signals (robots.txt AI-crawler Disallow, or Content-Signal: ai-train=no) and SKIPPED if it has opted out. Set 'respect_optout': false ONLY with explicit authorization for that source.
These entries use placeholder example.com URLs and will simply find nothing — replace them with a permitted source.
type: one of sitemap_index | flat_sitemap | paginated
common keys: name, source_domain, label (satire|authentic), requests_per_second (default 1.0), max_pages (optional), respect_optout (default true)
